name: Coco Dining
address: 143 Nam Ky Khoi Nghia Street, Xuan Hoa Ward, 700000, Ho Chi Minh City
dinnerNoteVi: Thực đơn nếm thử Lưu Tích

menus.name: Lưu Tích tasting menu
menus.note: Pairing price is The Journey; other pairings: The Explorer (wine, sake, cocktails) ₫3,000,000, The Heritage ₫4,500,000, The Spark (Champagne only) ₫5,500,000, The Botanic (alcohol-free) ₫2,500,000; prices before VAT and service charge

alsoTry.name: CoCo Grill
alsoTry.note: Chef Vương's à la carte wood-fire grill in the same villa

alsoTry.name: CoCo Bar
alsoTry.note: Cocktail and whisky bar in the same building, open until 1am

bookingOpens: Online on TableCheck, or by phone or email. Dinner from 5:30pm; last orders 8:30pm.
cancellation: Groups of four or more pay a deposit of half the menu price per guest. Half of it is refunded for cancellations 48 hours ahead; within 24 hours nothing is refunded. Tables are held for 15 minutes.
groups: The villa seats 50 on one floor or 100 across both floors for private events; a private room needs a deposit of ₫15,000,000 Monday to Thursday or ₫20,000,000 Friday to Sunday and on public holidays.
byob: Wine only: corkage ₫2,000,000 plus tax and service per 750ml bottle, ₫4,000,000 for spirits. No other outside food or drink.
